description: Crypto KOL tracker — send a token contract, get the big X/Twitter accounts posting about it, ranked by followers: handle, followers, verified, post count, first post time, best post, strong (exact address) or weak (cashtag only) match; plus kol_count, total_reach, first_call_at, a buzz label (none/low/rising/hot) and DexScreener price change. 8 chains incl. Base and Solana. 404/free if no account over the follower floor posted. Costs $0.02 per call, paid from clink's shop credits (an existing key; new top-ups are paused). A failed or empty call is free.
